name: Control serve primary lease admission and fail-closed states
target: Exercise the production control serve HTTP boundary with isolated state and injected lease reads; no cloud, GCS, or HQ host is contacted.
inputs: HQ expiresAt metadata with a fresh TTL lease
observations: measured GCS and HQ leases permit registration
absent, unreadable, malformed, and expired lease states return unknown primary and reject registration
GCS client-side expiresAt is rejected; HQ authority is computed from renewedAt and ttlSeconds
unmeasured reason is observable with the source and is not converted into authority
